q: How does a Panipat recycled yarn mill work out electricity per kg?
title: Panipat recycled yarn: power per kg
short: Multiply billed kWh by 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh and divide by kilograms of yarn spun in the same month. Mechanical recycling of waste into shoddy yarn runs mainly on electricity, so this is the mill's main own-energy line.
audience: Shoddy and recycled cotton yarn mills in the Panipat cluster of Haryana

p: kWh from the bill, including the opening and garnetting machines.
Multiply by 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh.
Divide by kg of yarn spun.
How you count the incoming textile waste depends on the method your buyer follows. Write down the rule, for example whether waste carries any upstream emissions.
